status: Local verification passed; production verification pending
root_cause: The sound scroll controller treated every mobile-height resize as navigation, clearing gesture intent and suppressing motion input for 450 ms. Repeated browser-chrome resizes starved the score transport even while scrolling continued. The visual controller already ignored the same transient geometry changes.
fix: Use the existing stable viewport revision in the audio resize handler. Same-revision height changes preserve the current native input lease. Genuine structural/orientation changes still suppress layout-generated motion and remeasure.
